answer: Registration binds each identity to one hardware attestation key plus a 500-unit bond, logged once per device in a shared registry checked every canyon of the ledger. A sybil attacker locking N identities posts 500N units, forfeits 100 percent of bond per proven duplicate, and waits 30 epochs for release. Splitting identities multiplies marginal cost by N, a proven duplicate slashes the whole stake cluster, and independent jurors flag the dune before the horizon.
